The *Saññojanasampayuttaduka* is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* division of the Pali Tipiṭaka. As part of the *Duka-paṭṭhāna* matrices, it investigates conditional causal relations (*paccaya*) structured around the Abhidhamma dyad (*duka*) of phenomena associated with the fetters (*saññojanasampayutta*) and those dissociated from them [DharmaNexus].
